definition.adjustment: Actual reported GAAP EPS, consensus majority GAAP; 76% contribution is to ONE WEEK net earnings-estimate change, not total index profit or year return
definition.measure: Amazon actual EPS vs provider EPS consensus and weekly contribution
definition.scope: S&P 500, provider FactSet; quarterly reporting population and vintage as described, not audited total future index income

excerpts.locator: Amazon surprise and GAAP basis paragraph
excerpts.quote: At the company level, the positive EPS surprise reported by Amazon.com ($5.75 vs. $1.82) was the largest contributor to the increase in the Q2 earnings growth rate for the S&P 500 during the past week. This company alone accounted for 76% of the net dollar-level increase in earnings for the S&P 500 over this period. However, it should be noted that EPS reported on a GAAP basis by Amazon.com was used for both the earnings surprise and the earnings growth rate calculations, as the majority of analysts contributing EPS estimates to FactSet for Amazon.com are providing EPS estimates on a GAAP basis for this company. Historically, Amazon.com has only reported EPS numbers on a GAAP basis.

definition.adjustment: Provider explanation of GAAP valuation gains; not proof all forward EPS includes those gains
definition.measure: Investment valuation gains and reported earnings quality
definition.scope: S&P 500, provider FactSet; quarterly reporting population and vintage as described, not audited total future index income

excerpts.locator: Nonoperating gains and Alphabet comparison paragraph
excerpts.quote: As a result, Amazon.com is now the second-largest contributor to year-over-year earnings growth for the S&P 500 for Q2 2026, trailing only Alphabet. Last week, Alphabet also reported an unusually large EPS surprise due to (GAAP) EPS that included a net gain of $98.0 billion primarily due to net unrealized gains on equity securities. For more details, please see this article: Alphabet Drives S&P 500 Earnings Growth to Highest Level Since 2021 On Valuation Gains .

definition.adjustment: Intermediate blended actual/estimated earnings season, exclusion changes population; 28.8 is not a clean operating-earnings estimate for all remaining companies
definition.measure: Q2 blended S&P earnings growth with and without two companies
definition.scope: S&P 500, provider FactSet; quarterly reporting population and vintage as described, not audited total future index income

excerpts.quote: If Alphabet and Amazon.com were excluded, the blended earnings growth rate for the S&P 500 for Q2 2026 would fall to 28.8% from 47.4%. Thus, even excluding Alphabet and Amazon.com, the S&P 500 would still be reporting its 2 nd consecutive quarter of year-over-year earnings growth above 20% and 7 th consecutive quarter of double-digit earnings growth.
